comment: Extra Wisp relays for AxBrowser. AxOS reads this file when it's hosted (next to index.html), so you can add or remove relays here without rebuilding. Relays listed here are added to the built-in list; set "off": true to hide a built-in one.

relays.name: Terbium
relays.note: The relay Terbium OS ships with

relays.name: FreeWisp
relays.note: 50 GiB/day per IP, web ports only

relays.name: PGIS
relays.note: Free host: the first request can take a minute to wake it

relays.name: Reeyuki
relays.note: Small community server on a free host

relays.name: Mercury Workshop
relays.note: Demo server, throttled to about 100 kB/s per IP
